releaseNotes: Multi-Storage Account / Dual-Bucket Aggregation: Added concurrent discovery across Primary and Secondary Cloudflare R2 Workers via Task.WhenAll, unifying multi-bucket game assets and expanding file library capacity to ~16GB+
Intelligent Download Routing & Origin Tracking: Each remote file tracks its originating storage worker (OriginBaseUrl) for direct high-speed streaming downloads
Automated HTTP 404 Fallback: Implemented automatic single-fallback download queries between Primary and Secondary workers when a file is missing or displaced on an individual bucket
Candidate Probing with Dual-Worker Fallback: Mod verification checks candidate list against Primary worker first, gracefully probing Secondary worker if 404 is returned

Security & Authentication Standardization: Updated all HTTP clients and worker calls to User-Agent 'GamerZoneLauncher/1.3.5 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)' and token 'GZ_LAUNCHER_AUTH_X99_SECURE_TOKEN'
Strict Profile Exclusion Preserved: Dedicated profile archive (47414d45525a4f4e452050524f.zip) remains strictly isolated from game mod update scans and routes exclusively through manual profile sync
Unified Central Progress Modal & Top-Center Alerts: Maintained consistent glassmorphic progress tracking and top-center notification alignment across all download operations
Process Safety & Tray Protection: Full support for single instance mutex, tray minimization, and eurotrucks2.exe termination on clean launcher exit
